mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raffle_activity(activity_id, activity_name, activity_desc, begin_date_time, end_date_time, strategy_id, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{activityDesc}, #{beginDateTime}, #{endDateTime}, #{strategyId}, #{state}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE raffle_activity SET activity_name=#{activityName}, activity_desc=#{activityDesc}, begin_date_time=#{beginDateTime}, end_date_time=#{endDateTime}, strategy_id=#{strategyId}, state=#{state}, update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
UPDATE raffle_activity SET state=#{state}, update_time=NOW() WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.select: SELECT activity_id FROM raffle_activity ORDER BY activity_id DESC limit 1;
